items.coder_A: Role depends on whether bevacizumab (established GBM therapy, new setting) counts as a second investigational agent; sintilimab is a candidate either way (monotherapy vs combination).
items.reason: Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) used in a new setting (adjuvant, newly diagnosed), so rule 6 applies and it is not investigational; sintilimab is then the only investigational agent ('adjuvant temozolomide combined with sintilimab and bevacizumab').

items.coder_A: Established GBM therapy given in a new setting (newly diagnosed, with PD-1 antibody); could instead be an experimental_combination candidate.
items.reason: Rule 6 covers an established GBM therapy 'in a new schedule, dose, route or setting'; bevacizumab 10 mg/kg q21d in newly diagnosed adjuvant therapy fits that.

Sintilimab starts only after chemoradiation ('After completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy, participants will receive adjuvant temozolomide combined with sintilimab and bevacizumab'), so radiotherapy is not given with the candidate; temozolomide and bevacizumab are. regimen stays combination.

note: Bevacizumab in newly diagnosed disease is not established standard care of this population, so it is not soc_backbone (D31-B7); as an established GBM therapy in a new setting it stays established_therapy_experiment (manual rule 6). combination_partners drop radiotherapy under D31-C2/C3 (not concurrent with sintilimab). Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.reason: Radiotherapy precedes sintilimab ('After completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy, participants will receive adjuvant temozolomide combined with sintilimab and bevacizumab'), so only concurrent temozolomide and bevacizumab are partners.
